image_description: A close-up photograph of a brown butterfly, identified as a ringlet, perched on yellow composite flowers. The butterfly's wings are held open/flat, displaying the dorsal side which is dark brown with distinct rows of black eyespots (ocelli) with white centers. A second partial butterfly is visible on the right edge. The background consists of soft-focus green foliage.

The legs attaching to the flower petals appear somewhat indistinct and 'melted' into the yellow petals. While obscured by focus, the connection lacks clear anatomical definition, appearing as a blur rather than distinct tarsi gripping the surface.

Additionally, the reduced forelegs were untestable. The biological structure is otherwise highly accurate.
